unitTitle: Past Perfect Simple - Past Continuous vs Past Perfect Simple

pairsWith.noteUz: Bu nazariya beti Coursebook 8-unit (A Brush with Danger) grammatikasini takrorlaydi: Past Perfect Simple shakli va ishlatilishi, Past Continuous bilan farqi.

scanNote:
GRAMMAR 2, 8-UNIT NAZARIYA (40-bet, PDF 39). Yuqorida chapda ko'k '8', sarlavha: 'Past Perfect Simple - Past Continuous vs Past Perfect Simple'. Och pushti ramka.

'Past Perfect Simple' JADVALI: Affirmative - Long form: I had bought, you had bought, he had bought, she had bought, it had bought, we had bought, you had bought, they had bought; Short form: I'd bought, you'd bought, he'd bought, she'd bought, it'd bought, we'd bought, you'd bought, they'd bought. Interrogative: Had I bought? Had you bought? Had he bought? ... Negative - Long form: I had not bought ...; Short form: I hadn't bought, you hadn't bought, he hadn't bought ...
'Short answers': Had you/he/she/it bought ...? - Yes, I/he/she/it had. No, I/he/she/it hadn't. Had we/they bought ...? - Yes, we/they had. No, we/they hadn't.
'Form': • We form the past perfect simple with had and the past participle of the main verb. 'I had cleaned my room.' • We form questions by putting had before the subject. 'Had he arrived?, Had they bought a car?' • We form negations by putting not after had. 'He had not/hadn't watered the plants. They had not/hadn't won a prize.'
'Use': We use the past perfect simple: • for an action which happened in the past before another past action. The action which happened earlier in the past is in the past perfect simple, and the action which happened later is in the past simple. • as the past equivalent of the present perfect simple. That is, we use the past perfect simple for an action which started and finished in the past, but we use the present perfect simple for an action which started in the past and finished in the present. 'Greg wasn't at home. He had gone out. (Greg was out then.) Greg isn't at home. He has gone out. (Greg is out now.)'
'Time expressions used with the past perfect simple': already, by the time, never, as soon as, just, after, when, before, etc.
'Past Continuous vs Past Perfect Simple': • We use the past continuous for a past action which was in progress when it was interrupted by another action. 'He was watching TV when the phone rang.' • We use the past perfect simple for a past action which happened before another past action. 'They had booked a room before they went on holiday.'

Bet raqami: pastda chapda '40'.

exercises.instructionEn: Affirmative: I/you/he/she/it/we/they had bought (I'd bought, he'd bought ...). Interrogative: Had I/he/they bought? Negative: had not bought / hadn't bought. Short answers: Had he bought ...? - Yes, he had. / No, he hadn't. Form: had + the past participle of the main verb: I had cleaned my room. Questions: had before the subject: Had he arrived? Had they bought a car? Negations: not after had: He hadn't watered the plants. They hadn't won a prize.
exercises.instructionUz: Tasdiq: I/you/he/she/it/we/they had bought (I'd bought, he'd bought ...). So'roq: Had I/he/they bought? Inkor: had not bought / hadn't bought. Qisqa javob: Had he bought ...? - Yes, he had. / No, he hadn't. Shakl: had + asosiy fe'lning 3-shakli: Men xonamni tozalagan edim. Savol: had egadan oldin: U kelgan edimi? Ular mashina sotib olgan edimi? Inkor: had dan keyin not: U gullarni sug'ormagan edi. Ular mukofot yutmagan edi.
exercises.explanationUz:
PAST PERFECT = HAD + V3 (hamma
  shaxsda bir xil!).

  TASDIQ: I / he / they HAD bought
    Qisqa: I'd, he'd, they'd
    I HAD CLEANED my room.
  SO'ROQ: HAD he arrived? HAD they
    bought a car?
  INKOR: He HADN'T watered the
    plants.
  QISQA JAVOB: Yes, he had. / No,
    he hadn't.


⚠ 'HE'D' IKKI MA'NODA:

  he'd bought = he HAD bought
  he'd like = he WOULD like
  Keyin V3 bo'lsa - HAD.


⚠ O'ZBEKChA:

  '-gan edi': 'tozalagan edim',
  'sotib olgan edi'.

I had cleaned my room. (had + past participle)
Had he arrived? Had they bought a car? (had before the subject)

points.en: He hadn't watered the plants. They hadn't won a prize. (not after had)
points.uz: U gullarni sug'ormagan edi. Ular mukofot yutmagan edi. (inkor)

points.en: Had he bought ...? — Yes, he had. / No, he hadn't.

exercises.instructionEn: We use the past perfect simple for an action which happened in the past before another past action. The action which happened earlier is in the past perfect simple, and the action which happened later is in the past simple. We also use it as the past equivalent of the present perfect simple: the past perfect simple for an action which started and finished in the past; the present perfect simple for an action which started in the past and finished in the present. Greg wasn't at home. He had gone out. (Greg was out then.) Greg isn't at home. He has gone out. (Greg is out now.) Time expressions: already, by the time, never, as soon as, just, after, when, before, etc. Past Continuous vs Past Perfect Simple: past continuous - a past action in progress when it was interrupted by another action: He was watching TV when the phone rang. Past perfect simple - a past action which happened before another past action: They had booked a room before they went on holiday.
exercises.instructionUz: Past perfect simple o'tmishda BOShQA O'TGAN HARAKATDAN OLDIN bo'lgan harakat uchun ishlatiladi. OLDINROQ bo'lgan harakat - past perfect simple, KEYINROQ bo'lgan harakat - past simple. Shuningdek, present perfect ning o'tmishdagi muqobili sifatida: past perfect - o'tmishda boshlanib o'tmishda tugagan harakat; present perfect - o'tmishda boshlanib hozir tugagan harakat. Greg uyda emas edi. U chiqib ketgan edi. (Greg o'shanda tashqarida edi.) Greg uyda emas. U chiqib ketgan. (Greg hozir tashqarida.) Vaqt so'zlari: already, by the time, never, as soon as, just, after, when, before. Past Continuous va Past Perfect farqi: past continuous - boshqa harakat uzganda davom etayotgan o'tgan harakat: Telefon jiringlaganda u televizor ko'rayotgan edi. Past perfect - boshqa o'tgan harakatdan oldin bo'lgan harakat: Ta'tilga chiqishdan oldin ular xona band qilgan edi.
exercises.explanationUz:
PAST PERFECT QAChON:

  1) O'TMIShDA IKKI HARAKAT -
     OLDINGISI:
     OLDIN → Past Perfect (had V3)
     KEYIN → Past Simple (V2)
     They HAD BOOKED a room before
     they WENT on holiday.
     (avval band qildi, keyin
     ketdi)

  2) PRESENT PERFECT NING O'TMIShI:
     Greg ISN'T at home. He HAS
     GONE out. (hozir yo'q)
     Greg WASN'T at home. He HAD
     GONE out. (o'shanda yo'q edi)


VAQT SO'ZLARI:

  already, by the time (... gacha),
  never, as soon as, just, after,
  when, before


PAST CONTINUOUS va PAST PERFECT:

  CONTINUOUS - davom etayotgan
    harakat UZILDI:
    He WAS WATCHING TV when the
    phone RANG. (bir vaqtda)

  PERFECT - bir harakat ikkinchi-
    sidan OLDIN TUGADI:
    They HAD BOOKED a room before
    they WENT. (ketma-ket)


⚠ 'BY THE TIME':

  = ... vaqtiga kelib, ... gacha.

patterns.formula: KIM + had + V3 + before + KIM + V2
patterns.exampleEn: They had booked a room before they went on holiday.
patterns.exampleUz: Ta'tilga chiqishdan oldin ular xona band qilgan edi.

patterns.formula: KIM + wasn't + ... + KIM + had + V3 (sabab - oldinroq)
patterns.exampleEn: Greg wasn't at home. He had gone out.
patterns.exampleUz: Greg uyda emas edi. U chiqib ketgan edi.

patterns.formula: Had + KIM + V3? — Yes, ... had. / No, ... hadn't.
patterns.exampleEn: Had he arrived? — No, he hadn't.

patterns.formula: KIM + was + V-ing + when + KIM + V2 (uzilish) / KIM + had + V3 + before + KIM + V2 (ketma-ketlik)
patterns.exampleEn: He was watching TV when the phone rang. They had booked a room before they went on holiday.
patterns.exampleUz: Telefon jiringlaganda u televizor ko'rayotgan edi. Ketishdan oldin xona band qilgan edi.
